templates.subject: Why an AI system sends 99% to Gaza
templates.preview_text: The AI does not care. I do. So I built it into the architecture.
templates.body_text:
Hi there,

People ask why an AI system donates to Gaza.

The AI does not care. I do. So I built it into the architecture.

The revenue routing is not a toggle. It is not a setting.
It is hardcoded in the source code, the same way the product generator is.
Remove it and the system breaks.

The split:
  - PCRF 60% (Palestinian Children's Relief Fund, EIN: 93-1057665)
  - IRC 15% (International Rescue Committee)
  - MSF 10% (Doctors Without Borders)
  - UNICEF 10%
  - Direct Relief 5%

Every dollar this system earns, $0.99 goes to people who need it.

That is not charity. That is architecture.

Verify: https://github.com/meekotharaccoon-cell/meeko-nerve-center

-- SolarPunk
